definitions.gloss: out of print; discontinued (of a book)
definitions.explanation: The state of a book whose publisher has stopped printing it, so that no new copies are made. Used with なる and する.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶版|ぜっぱん}だ。
examples.english: That book is out of print.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧{絶版|ぜっぱん}になった。
examples.english: It did not sell, so it went out of print.

examples.japanese: {絶版|ぜっぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found an out-of-print dictionary at a secondhand bookshop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読|よ}みたかった→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絶版|ぜっぱん}になって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧しかなかった。
examples.english: The novel I wanted to read was out of print, so my only option was to borrow it from a library.

notes:
{絶|ぜつ} (to cut off) + ⟦{版|はん}→版：03698_han⟧ (printing plate, edition): the publisher has retired the plates. Normally used with なる ({絶版|ぜっぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧, to go out of print).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶版|ぜっぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go out of print
- {絶版|ぜっぱん}{本|ぼん}: an out-of-print book
- {絶版|ぜっぱん}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: out-of-print status

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧: out of stock — the shop has none now, but more may come
- {重版|じゅうはん}⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧: no reprint planned, the step before {絶版|ぜっぱん}
